title: Assessing the effect of article processing charges on the geographic diversity of authors using Elsevier's 'Mirror Journal' system
notes: MATCHES (zero OA Mirror articles from low-income authors) - but see inconsistency note. Abstract (preprint p.3): 'Author Geographic Diversity of OA articles was significantly lower than that of non-OA articles. Most OA articles were written by authors in high-income countries, and there were no articles in Mirror journals by authors in low-income countries.' p.13: none of 975 Mirror articles and 0.15% of Parent articles had lead authors in low-income countries.
